Item shape: {"id": "short-kebab-id", "week": "2026-W42", "type": "new-post|rewrite-post|fold-post|page-fix|technical|compliance|local|geo|measurement|decision", "cluster": "a key of blog/tools/clusters.json", "url": "/blog/<slug> or the live path", "title": "", "targetQueries": ["GSC queries the item targets"], "readerStage": "recovering|deciding", "status": "todo|in-progress|rehearsed|live|measured|dropped", "owner": "", "notes": "", "liveOn": null}. rehearsed = SQL applied on a throwaway clone and rendered; live = the user ran it on production and it was revalidated (set liveOn to the date); measured = the day-28 readout is in. Posts live in blog/posts/<slug>/; see blog/README.md. Weeks here are numbers counted from week1 (Mon 2026-10-12); the strategy artifact is the source of the plan and holds the same item ids.
planName: Money Pages First, Claims Cleared: 26-week SEO and blog plan for alluringplasticsurgery.com (12 Oct 2026 to 11 Apr 2027)

phases.name: Phase 1: Clean and hold
phases.goal: Ship the form fix on day 1. Remove the claims and wrong prices at the source (PR-A1 in week 1; PR-A2 with PR-B in week 2) and the compliance-family claims from all 131 post bodies. Freeze the automated writers. Read the v2 test against position-matched controls and apply the verdict. Ship PR-B, built in week 1 behind a flag: the face folds with their absorbed sections, the 6 general retirements and the registry infrastructure. Run the primary-source credential checks and get the questions to counsel, the practice and the user. Re-pull every baseline in its target's own unit, with a seasonal factor, a RUM baseline and frozen controls.
phases.exitCriteria: The form hotfix is live and lead_submit_error is at 0. PR-A1 is live. PR-A2 is live with PR-B (or queued with PR-C), and together they bring the site-claims check over apps/web, packages/ai, packages/chat and packages/shared to 0. A crawl of the sitemap plus /landing/*, /lp/*, book.alluringplasticsurgery.com, the quiz result step, promotions and the llms files finds 0 hits. R2a returns 0 for the false-credential subset on non-v2 posts (Fri 16 Oct). R2b returns 0 on the compliance families on all posts, with no protected title changed (Fri 23 Oct). The patient-photo heroes and the size-guide chart are replaced unless consent is confirmed in writing. refresh_mode='off' and autopilot_mode='off', with 0 pending, ready_for_review or in_progress refresh rows and all failed runs acknowledged. The v2 verdict is recorded and applied in PR-B. PR-B is live with 12 folds, 5 x 410 and 1 x 308, one 308 hop per URL form, and the registry test passing at 113 live. The BBL owner map is drafted. The KPI baseline sheet is stored with the seasonal factor, the RUM baseline and the frozen control lists.

phases.name: Phase 2: Fold and rebuild
phases.goal: Ship the BA, BL, MM and BR modules, each with its fold batch. BA ships in week 4 alongside PR-D if its hero pick slips. Fold the TT cluster after the TT day-28 read. Ship PR-F: the credentials section, counsel's 456.062 component, the old-template fixes and face titles, and the financing #prices section (plus the explainer if counsel approves it). Complete 35 unprotected rewrites (36 with the explainer), each run starting with the posts that absorb that week's folds, while the 7-post holdout H stays frozen. Start the review cadence and the clinic-owned listing cleanup.
phases.exitCriteria: 4 modules are live and indexed. 57 retirements are live with rows deleted (56 if the explainer reuses a row), and the registry is at 74 live (75). The procedure_link_click event is reporting, and the CI lint (site-claims list and allowlist over the four paths) is green. TT-fold day-28 read (7 Dec, week 9): 'tummy tuck cost miami' is served by the TT page, with the financing page tracked as a possible owner. BA day-28 read (30 Nov): the BA page ranks 35 or better for 'breast augmentation miami', against its 28-day baseline of 68.2. The survivor set is no more than 10 points worse than the holdout H.

phases.name: Phase 3: Tune and read through the holidays
phases.goal: Tune the BBL and lipo pages from their day-56 reads. Rewrite the 3 BBL snippet posts (R10). Build the facelift module. Run only reads in the Christmas and New Year weeks, including the lipo day-90 read and the first day-56 reads of the rewrite batches.
phases.exitCriteria: PR-J is live. 38 of 45 unprotected rewrites are done (39 of 46 with the explainer), and the 7 holdout posts follow in week 16. The reads due in these weeks are logged with a seasonality flag: BL and R5 day-28; face folds day-56; PR-F day-28; R6 day-28; R2b-2 day-56; BA day-56; R7 day-28; R3 day-56; lipo day-90.

phases.name: Phase 4: Protect the earners and extend
phases.goal: Run the 90-day review, raw and seasonally adjusted. Ship a crawlable /blog (week 13) and the facelift module (week 14). Rewrite protected batch P1 (end of week 14), the holdout H (week 16) and P2 (end of week 18). Ship bleph, PR-N (Spanish infrastructure plus the locale migration) and the es BBL, TT and MM pages. Keep refresh 'off' and record the conditions for resuming it. Publish the first new English post and the first Spanish post.
phases.exitCriteria: The 90-day KPI review is published, raw and seasonally adjusted. P1's 21-day gate (read 9 Feb) is -5 points or better against its frozen control, and P2 has shipped. The holdout H is rewritten. Facelift and bleph are live. All live posts are linked from crawlable /blog HTML. The blog_post.locale migration is applied in prod. The es BBL and TT pages are indexed with valid reciprocal hreflang, and the es MM page has shipped (its indexing is checked at the week-19 read). The stay-in-Miami post is indexed. The Spanish TT recovery post is published (its indexing is checked at the week-19 read). refresh_mode is still 'off'.

phases.name: Phase 5: Video, home hub, compound and review
phases.goal: Embed the surgeon explainers, ship the home local hub and the day-56 tuning, and finish the Spanish set. Run P3 (end of week 22) and, if its gate passes, P4 (end of week 26). Repair regressions and run the quarterly fact refresh, in which frozen control posts are checked but fixed only after their gate. Run the third compliance crawl, then publish the 180-day review and the next plan.
phases.exitCriteria: VideoObject is valid on 6 URLs. The P2 gate (9 Mar) and P3 gate (6 Apr) are read and logged. All KPIs are read against their baselines at day 180. 0 price mismatches against docs/pricing across code, all kept posts and the 17 lipo posts; fixes on frozen control posts land after the P3 gate.
